name: @kestrel-agents/memory
description: Governed memory contracts and retrieval gateway for Kestrel agents

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.smoke:import: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(({ MemoryGateway, InMemoryMemoryBackend, parseMemoryQueryV1 }) => { void MemoryGateway; void InMemoryMemoryBackend; void parseMemoryQueryV1; })"
scripts.release:check: pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke:import && node --import tsx scripts/release-check.ts
